name: Journey: Rebirth
source:
Our story follows the MC who has hit rock bottom, no family, no money, no future, until one day a knock at the door changes everything. What should have been the break he’d been waiting for, instead pulls him into a world of new wealth, drama, and carefully kept secrets. He isn’t sure where he belongs in all of this, but one thing is certain: nothing is ever as simple as it seems. 

Along the way, he’ll meet people who could become allies, romances, rivals… or all three. Who to trust, who to love, who to betray, that’s all up to you.
translation:
我们的故事讲述的是一位陷入人生最低谷的主持人，没有家庭，没有金钱，没有未来，直到有一天，一声敲门声改变了一切。本应是他一直在等待的休​​息，却把他带入了一个充满新财富、戏剧性和精心保守的秘密的世界。他不确定自己在这一切中属于哪里，但有一件事是肯定的：没有什么事情像看起来那么简单。

一路上，他会遇到可能成为盟友、恋人、竞争对手……或三者兼而有之的人。信任谁，爱谁，背叛谁，一切都取决于你。
